errors.evidence: The estimated percentages for the inner slices are inaccurate. The "Real Characters" slice is described as 25%, which would be a 90-degree angle (a quarter of the circle), but it is visibly smaller than that, closer to 20%. Consequently, the other estimates are also skewed; "Virtual Characters" appears to be larger than 60% (closer to 65-70%) and "Custom Characters" appears smaller than 15% (closer to 10-12%).
The text for the outer category labels is a heavier font weight than the inner labels, but describing it as "bolded" is an overstatement. A more neutral description would be "heavier font weight".
